messages:
noah: FYI — hit a parity + retry edge between Node and Python sampleapps calling embeddings/rerank. Node batch helper produced a short final vector in one run -> server rejected with an embed-dim error and our middleware retried the entire batch, leading to duplicate submissions.

noah: repro snippet (node):
```js
const raw = Buffer.concat(vecs.map(v => Buffer.from(new Float32Array(v).buffer)));
const payload = { model: 'redwood-embed-001', data: raw.toString('base64') };
await fetch('/v1/embeddings', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(payload) });
```

tara: do you have the exact sizes? might be an off-by-one when slicing Float32Array views. :thinking_face:

noah: lengths logged [4096, 4096, 4092] in failing run. python sample never hits it.

ben: two action items: 1) SDK-level validation before send (strict by default; opt-in pad/truncate); 2) change sampleapp retry policy so structural 4xx (embed-dim errors) are non-retryable.

noah: temp local hack was padShort(vecs, expectedDim) so tests continue, but agree we shouldn't silently mutate input.

ben: also noticed response-shape drift: python wrapper returns objects with explicit "id" fields; node wrapper returned an array-only shape in one run. normalise SDK output to always include ids to avoid index fragility after dedupe.

ci-bot: opened PR #845: "js-sdk: preflight vector validation + validationMode (strict|pad|truncate); sampleapp: narrow 4xx retry rules". CI running.

ops-bot: raising ops note — retry loops can duplicate billable requests. tagging billing to audit recent spikes. :money_with_wings:

tara: i'll add an integration test that runs Node+Python sampleapps against a tiny local embed server and compares dims/ids. include fuzz cases for base64 vs JSON array payloads. add to CI matrix.

noah: thanks — will attach a minimal gist with failing base64 repro to the PR. keeping thread open for any follow-ups. :rocket:
